pr_title: Stereo calibration fixed when intrinsic guess is given
pr_body:
Fixes #22421
Connected test data PR: [#1003@extra](https://github.com/opencv/opencv_extra/pull/1003)

### Changes
* Stereo Calibration is fixed for cases when intrinsic camera matrices are provided by user and don't have to be recomputed
  * Erroneous variable initialization removed, see [this commit](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/22460/commits/96e2d326185fd1639238c8158ff9daf10d25c712)
* Regression test for the case
* Less address arithmetics, making valgrind happy
* Fix for `CALIB_SAME_FOCAL_LENGTH` flag:
  * Volatile variable (i.e. that is changed by the callback) made mask-fixed as it should be
  * See [this commit](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/pull/22460/commits/a8b4ffac50b195670fef2c0017a36b38d223ad81)
* Other `stereoCalibrateImpl()` refactoring changes

### TODOs for next PRs to improve convergence:
* Implement SE(3) exponential increment
* Try classic callback (no J^T * J and J^T * b, just J and b) for geodesic acceleration

### Pull Request Readiness Checklist

See details at https://github.com/opencv/opencv/wiki/How_to_contribute#making-a-good-pull-request

- [x] I agree to contribute to the project under Apache 2 License.
- [x] To the best of my knowledge, the proposed patch is not based on a code under GPL or another license that is incompatible with OpenCV
- [x] The PR is proposed to the proper branch
- [x] There is a reference to the original bug report and related work
- [x] There is accuracy test, performance test and test data in opencv_extra repository, if applicable
      Patch to opencv_extra has the same branch name.
- [x] The feature is well documented and sample code can be built with the project CMake

issue_context.title: LevMarq does not converge at stereo calibration
issue_context.body:
##### System information (version)

- OpenCV => 5.x
- Operating System / Platform => Ubuntu 20.04 (can be OS-independent)
- Compiler => GCC 9.4.0 (can be compiler-independent)

##### Detailed description

Was discovered by @ivashmak 

The final optimization in `stereoCalibrate` does not converge to some practical values.
It's known that it converged in 4.x when the old LevMarq engine was used.

##### Steps to reproduce

Compile & run `main.cpp` with OpenCV 5.x, the final optimization result should be the same as in `log.txt`.

See the zip file attached.

##### Issue submission checklist

 - [x] I report the issue, it's not a question
 - [x] I checked the problem with documentation, FAQ, open issues,
       forum.opencv.org, Stack Overflow, etc and have not found any solution
 - [x] I updated to the latest OpenCV version and the issue is still there
 - [x] There is reproducer code and related data files: videos, images, onnx, etc

[levmarqstereo.zip](https://github.com/opencv/opencv/files/9410523/levmarqstereo.zip)
